hooks.command: n=$(( $(cat '{artifact_root}/seq-project-settings' 2>/dev/null || echo 0) + 1 )); printf '%s' "$n" > '{artifact_root}/seq-project-settings'; curl -sS -m 5 -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'X-GoalCup-Event: SessionStart' -H 'X-GoalCup-Token: {receiver_token}' -H 'X-GoalCup-Entry: {entry_id}' -H 'X-GoalCup-Source: project-settings' -H "X-GoalCup-Seq: $n" --data-binary @- {receiver_http}/SessionStart >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

n=$(( $(cat '{artifact_root}/seq-project-settings' 2>/dev/null || echo 0) + 1 )); printf '%s' "$n" > '{artifact_root}/seq-project-settings'; curl -sS -m 5 -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'X-GoalCup-Event: UserPromptSubmit' -H 'X-GoalCup-Token: {receiver_token}' -H 'X-GoalCup-Entry: {entry_id}' -H 'X-GoalCup-Source: project-settings' -H "X-GoalCup-Seq: $n" --data-binary @- {receiver_http}/UserPromptSubmit-cmd || true
